annotation.title_clean: Regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council laying down harmonised rules on artificial intelligence (Artificial Intelligence Act)
annotation.title_en: Regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council laying down harmonised rules on artificial intelligence (Artificial Intelligence Act)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: European Parliament and Council of the European Union
annotation.summary_en: The EU Artificial Intelligence Act (Regulation 2024/1689), adopted 13 June 2024, sets harmonised rules for AI systems using a risk-based approach: prohibited practices, high-risk system requirements, general-purpose AI model obligations, conformity assessment, governance bodies and penalties. It covers AI as safety components of regulated products such as machinery, vehicles and medical devices.
key_provisions_or_claims: Prohibits certain AI practices such as manipulative techniques, social scoring and certain real-time remote biometric identification.

High-risk AI systems, including safety components of products under Annex I harmonisation legislation, face requirements on risk management, data governance, documentation, logging, human oversight and robustness.
Conformity assessment, CE marking, registration and post-market monitoring apply to high-risk systems.
General-purpose AI models face transparency obligations, with extra duties for systemic-risk models.
Establishes the AI Office, AI Board, national authorities, regulatory sandboxes and penalties.
